core_meaning.primary_meaning: Abaan is recorded with the Arabic-script form أبان. Reliable lexicons document the verb أبانَ with senses such as “to make clear,” “to express clearly,” and “to separate,” but those verb senses do not automatically establish the meaning of the personal name Abaan. Previously supplied glosses such as “first frost” remain unverified.
